title: BNCI 2020-002 Attention Shift (Covert Spatial Attention) dataset
description: EEG recordings from 18 healthy participants performing a gaze-independent brain-computer interface task based on covert spatial attention shifts. Participants answered yes/no questions by directing attention to a green or red cross while maintaining central fixation, and the resulting N2pc-related responses were classified with canonical correlation analysis. The dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the BNCI Horizon 2020 data, distributed via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 30 channels plus 2 EOG channels using a BrainAmp DC amplifier with Ag/AgCl electrodes (extended 10-20 montage, right mastoid reference, 250 Hz sampling rate). Colored crosses (green + and red x) were presented for 250 ms with an SOA of 850 ms (jittered), in 10 repetitions per trial across 7 blocks. Analysis used re-referencing to averaged mastoids, 1.0-12.5 Hz Butterworth bandpass filtering, downsampling to 50 Hz, and epoching 0-750 ms after stimulus onset.
